description: This file is a header declaration for the libIARM Bus API, defining function signatures, callback types, and enumerations for inter-process communication within the RDK platform. It includes interface functions for initializing, connecting, registering handlers, broadcasting events, and invoking remote procedures, as well as relevant typedefs and documentation comments.
